summary: READ-ONLY QA audit of CR-385 static front-desk mockup (v2.25). Measured cross-screen amounts on hooks ?bill=102/113, ?checkin=a2, ?open=a1:cancel, ?room=101:extend, ?room=119/223, ?booking=1 at 1920x1080/1024x768/768x1024. No source file was modified. Console is clean (0 errors, 0 warnings) on every hook exercised. Multiple confirmed cross-screen inconsistencies, hardcoded bill figures, missing validation on Extend/Modify, and dismissal-label inconsistency documented below.

ui_bugs.issue: P0 · Room booking amount, advance and GST are HARDCODED (roomAmt=1000, adv=100, gst=50 → total ₹950) regardless of the guest, booking, room type, nights, source, or actual advance. Measured on ?bill=102 (R. Fernandes · MakeMyTrip · Executive · 1 night · 2A → still shows ₹1,000/₹-100/₹950) AND on ?bill=113 (H. Shetty · Executive · 3 nights → still ₹1,000/₹-100/₹0 because a synthetic ₹950 'Other room payments' line zeros it). Source: line 560 `const adv=100,roomAmt=1000`.

P0 · The SAME booking shows different amounts on each screen. Booking a1 (J. Pereira · Booking.com · Executive · 3 nights · 16→19 Sep) — Arrivals row ₹ column = ₹1,000; Cancel dialog prepaid = ₹3,000 (penalty ₹1,000, refund due ₹2,000); Modify computes current using (rate+plan)×n = 3300×3+5% ≈ ₹10,395; Check-In (measured on a2 same shape) 'Booked charge · 3 nights' = ₹2,200 (single-night amt, NOT multiplied). Row uses o.amt (single night); Modify uses per-night rate×n; Cancel/No-Show uses amt×nights; Check-In uses amt only. Four disagreeing figures for one booking. Sources: rowHTML line 432 (o.amt), modFigures line 510 (t.rate×n), prepaidOf line 549 (amt×n), ciContext line 641 (charge=line.amt).

P1 · Overpayment yields NEGATIVE 'Balance remaining' and Confirm stays enabled. Test on ?room=101:extend, Collect=999999, Cash → extend-total-payable = ₹3,465; extend-balance-remaining = ₹-9,96,534; readiness = 'Ready · collect ₹9,99,999 now'; extend-confirm-button disabled=null (enabled). Also the currency format '₹-9,96,534' places the minus after the ₹ symbol (should be −₹9,96,534). No clamp: line 474 `balanceRemaining=Math.round((totalPayable-collected)*100)/100`.

P1 · Adults input can be cleared to blank AND check-in can be set to a past date (e.g. 2026-09-01 vs T=2026-09-17) yet Save stays enabled. Measured on ?room=119 kebab › Modify with adults='' and cin='2026-09-01', reason='test' → modify-save-button disabled=null, readiness='Ready · collect ₹55,440'. Missing guards: modMissing() (line 511) has no adults>=1 check and no cin>=T check.

P2 · Currency formats mix within one bill. Room block uses money() (no decimals): ₹1,000, +₹25, ₹950. F&B block uses .toFixed(2): ₹17.48 CGST, ₹17.48 SGST, +₹0.04 round-off, but item totals & total use money() (₹699, ₹734). Round off correctness: subtotal 699 × 0.025 = 17.475 (shown 17.48 twice; sum 34.96); ceil(699+34.96)=734 → round-off shown +₹0.04 while real diff = 734−733.96 = 0.04 (ok). But visual inconsistency remains a UI defect.

ui_bugs.component: Bill · payment header order & tax label order
ui_bugs.issue: P2 · Section-to-section header inconsistency. Room block lists SGST before CGST; F&B block lists CGST before SGST (line 589 vs 578).
P2 · 'Received' text is hard-wired to grand total (`${money(grand)} received` line 596). No partial-payment input available; the label always claims full amount received even before any pay-action.

P2 · Five different close labels for the same 'dismiss dialog' action: Bill='Close', Check-In='Close', Extend='✕ Cancel', Booking='✕ Cancel', No-Show='✕ Close', Cancel='✕ Close', Room detail='✕'. Recommend a single label and glyph.

ui_bugs.component: Arrivals action colour vs kebab colour
ui_bugs.issue: P2 · No-Show is red on the expired row button (btn dg, line 435) but amber in the kebab menu (color:var(--am), line 804) and red again on the dialog Confirm button. Cancel is red everywhere. Verified: room 223 (Booking.com) kebab HTML style='color:var(--am)'; row button and dialog use btn dg.
P3 (observation) · a1 is Booking.com (OTA) yet the hook opens the Cancel dialog directly. Elsewhere OTA rows only offer No-Show. Deep-link hook does not enforce the isOTA rule.

P3 · line 451 defines leaving=cout<=T which folds overdue into 'Leaving today'. In current mock overdue=0 so tabs read '4 leaving today' matching Departures '4 today'; but any overdue guest will silently inflate the In-House leaving count vs Departures Today.

P3 · Bill card uses 'night(s)' and 'day(s)' (line 564, 834) while Arrivals/In-House use 'nights'/'night' with runtime pluralisation. Room tile sub-line prints raw ISO date 'out 2026-09-19' (line 816) vs '19 Sep' elsewhere.

P3 · S.paymentRef, S.payMethod, S.fdT/V/R, S.cpn, S.loy are global mock state — they persist across different bills opened during a session, potentially leaking discount/coupon from one guest's bill to another when navigating.

issues: Section headers, tax order and decimal precision differ between Room and F&B blocks (see ui_bugs above).
Payment 'received' always equals grand; no partial-pay field.
Negative balance rendered as '₹-9,96,534' (minus after currency symbol).
No validation for over-collection or past dates.

action_items: P0 Fix checkout Bill to compute roomAmt from the guest booking (rate, nights, plan supp, actual advance) — replace hard-coded adv=100/roomAmt=1000 (line 560).

P0 Reconcile the four sources of 'booking amount' so Arrivals row · Modify current · Cancel/No-Show prepaid · Check-In room-amount agree for one booking. Prefer per-night rate × nights everywhere and remove reliance on o.amt as a single-night value.
P1 Clamp Extend balance-remaining at 0 (or block Confirm) when collect > totalPayable; format negatives as '−₹X'.
P1 Add Modify validation: adults >= 1, check-in >= today, and pin these into modMissing().
P2 Unify decimal formatting & tax-line order between Room and F&B bill blocks; unify close-button label across dialogs.
P2 Replace hard-coded 'received' text with a proper amount input and show short-payment vs overpay clearly.
P3 Fix In-House 'leaving today' filter to cout===T (exclude overdue) to match Departures.
P3 Reset per-bill state (S.paymentRef, S.fdT/V/R, S.cpn, S.loy, S.payMethod) when switching bills.
P3 Standardise pluralisation ('night(s)') and date formatting on room tile sub-line.
critical_code_review_comments: Single-file mockup is 890 lines — beyond the 700-line threshold; split into modules (state, render, expansions, rooms, search) for maintainability.
State is a monolithic global S{} object — no per-view reset when opening a different guest's bill leads to leakage of discount/coupon/loyalty.

checkout() (line 799) mutates `guests` (filter) but never updates `counters.checkedOut` visibly on the tab strip until re-render; small footer counter increments — OK, but a rapid double-click could still call checkout() twice on distinct guests; guard by disabling the button after first click.
Money helper uses toLocaleString('en-IN') which formats negatives as '-₹X' inconsistently — see Extend negative case.
prepaidOf/nsPenalty/cancelPenalty use amt×nights while ciContext uses only amt — the discrepancy is the root cause of H1 cross-screen mismatch.

measured_values.H10_tab_strip: Arrivals 6 · 6 today · 3 late | Departures 4 · 4 today · 0 overdue | In-House 18 · 18 guests · 4 leaving today · 6 arrived today | Rooms 45% · 12 free · 18/40 occupied · 5 HK · 1 OOO

context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a read-only audit; do not modify the mockup. Priority is the amount-source mismatch (H1) and the hard-coded checkout Bill (H2); once main-agent unifies the amount source, re-verify a1/a2 row ₹, Modify current, Cancel prepaid, Check-in room-amount all agree. Also re-check Extend negative-balance clamp and Modify blank-adults/past-date guards. Playwright evidence captured programmatically; no screenshots persisted (all measured via data-testid).
rca of the issue: Different bill-computing functions read different fields for 'amount': rowHTML uses o.amt (single-night rate); modFigures uses (rate+plan.supp)*n; prepaidOf uses amt*n; ciContext uses only line.amt. Additionally, the Checkout expansion hard-codes roomAmt=1000/adv=100 (line 560) instead of deriving from the guest record. Consolidate into a single computeBookingCharge(bookingOrGuest) helper (rate × nights ± plan supplement) and refer every screen to it.
